header: A status word and a dot per service
lead: Editors pick a status, never a colour. The status sets both the dot and the word, so the state never depends on colour alone.
note: Put the date and time in this note. A status list shows what someone published, not what is happening now.

metrics.title: A service that is degraded
metrics.text: Use the detail line for the reason and the expected end date.

metrics.title: A service with no status chosen
metrics.text: Without a status the dot is neutral, never green.
